description.short_caption: Erythematous plaques with raised, scaly borders on the skin.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows multiple erythematous plaques with well-demarcated, raised, scaly borders. The lesions are annular and coalesce in some areas, forming larger patches. The central areas of the plaques appear relatively less inflamed compared to the borders. The image suggests a superficial fungal infection, such as tinea corporis (ringworm).
